info.title: Client Integration API
info.description: Public endpoints for client integration: OAuth/OAuth2 login/logout, person POST APIs, and hashed MSISDN upload.

post.description: Clears trusted-device cookie and revokes trusted devices for the authenticated user
Generates a JWT token for authentication. Supports form-urlencoded, JSON, and XML request bodies; XML responses when Accept requests XML.
Clears trusted-device cookie and revokes trusted devices for the authenticated user
Generates JWT token with OAuth2-client-scoped roles and scopes. Supports form-urlencoded, JSON, and XML request bodies; XML responses when Accept requests XML.
Upload hashed MSISDNs for contributor matching. Request body uses the Msisdns model.

post.summary: Get person aggregated credit history by cellphoneNumber, email and idNumber
post.description: Returns person aggregated credit history from AMG API. Request body uses the PersonCreditHistoryAggregatedQuery model.

post.summary: Get person information by phone number
post.description: Returns person information from multiple external APIs (contributors) based on phone number. Request body uses the PersonQuery model (JSON or XML with xmlns="urn:lenderlink:person-query:v1"). CRIF XML responses when Accept is text/xml+crif and the CRIF Full Response post-hook is configured.

post.summary: Get person mega report based on productIds
post.description: Returns HIT-only person information keyed by regular or database-configured standalone product code. Response productIds contains only products that returned a Hit. Legacy PT and standalone PT products are mutually exclusive within one request. Request body uses the MegaReportPayload model.

403.description: Forbidden: insufficient token scope or a requested standalone Payment Transaction product is not enabled for the client

post.summary: Get person payment transactions by phone number or email
post.description: Returns person information for payment transactions from multiple external APIs (contributors) based on phone number or email. Request body uses the PersonPaymentTransactionsQuery model.

post.summary: Get person information by phone number (lite)
post.description: Returns person lite summary for a cellphone number. Request body uses the PersonLiteQuery model.

post.summary: Get payment transactions for configured standalone products
post.description: Returns one aggregate report with productIds, matchFlag, and data. Only Hit products appear in productIds and the corresponding data keys, in requested order. Each data value preserves the provider values and nesting with recursively camelCase-normalized keys. matchFlag is Hit when at least one product Hits; otherwise HTTP 200 returns productIds: [], matchFlag: "No Hit", data: {}. Non-Hit and isolated-error products are omitted; request-level errors retain their existing HTTP status.

200.description: Aggregated Hit-only payment transaction report. Complete No Hit returns productIds=[], matchFlag="No Hit", data={}
